source_editability: STEP and BREP contain exact analytic shapes for direct editing, not the original parametric construction history.
frame_notes: All parts except the portrait stand use the case-native CAD frame. Print STLs already use their recorded bed pose.
The portrait stand CAD, assembly mesh and print mesh use its authored world Z-up frame; native_to_print is identity.
The viewer maps that Z-up stand frame with a proper -90 degree X rotation. Its former browser-only Y/Z-exchange mesh is excluded.
validation_limits: Nominal CAD and mesh checks do not establish printed tolerances, bed adhesion, insert strength, button lifetime or accessory holding force.
Accessory grip and cycle life require physical checking; use gentle pressure and trim only the tiny raised ribs if necessary.
The retained portrait stand has no released printer recipe. Current geometry must be sliced and checked for the selected machine.
Mechanical battery space does not qualify a battery/charger combination or connector wiring.
